title: The Window Tint Industry Fails
text:
The Window Tint Industry Fails. I have now bought the same product three times from two different sellers. On two of the rolls the tint sheet was not laid flat to the protective clear sheet resulting to permanent bunching up and scars/flaws in the window once it is applied.
It is maddening to carefully cut pieces and go through all the steps to apply it to the window only then to discover a flaw the size and thickness of a medium-small worm almost dead center of a main center window. This has happened twice. I don’t have the health or stamina to keep doing this over and over in hopes that maybe the next or replacement roll will be flaw-free. Nor should I have to.
I know these sellers don’t control the quality of the product but they do choose what to carry and from whom. If my experiences with this type of product are representative they might want to rethink their product line and the companies from where they they buy said products. So far my orders have a 66% FAILURE RATE! Buyer Beware!

features: UV BLOCKING & GLARE CONTROL: KESPEN sun blocking window film can effectively block 79% of infrared rays and 80% of UV rays, which may hurt your skin, prevent your precious furniture and interior decorations from fading. 28% VLT means that some visible light can enter the room, not only to block the harsh light reduce glare, but also to maintain your good view.

HEAT CONTROL & ENERGY SAVING: The window tinting film for home is designed to reflect some of the heat back outside, thus reducing the amount of heat transmitted through window glass, which can keep cool in summer and retain heat in winter, helping you save money by cutting the high energy bills.

DAYTIME PRIVACY PROTECTION: This one way window film ONLY provides superb privacy during the daytime, the mirror reflection design of privacy control window film allows others to not see any of your interior from the outside, effectively protect your private space.But when the inside light is stronger than outside, such as the lights turn on, the mirror effect will disappear and the inside will be seen from outside. So at night with this mirror tint, it is necessary to draw the curtains.

STATIC CLING & EASY TO INSTALL: The reflective window film design with non glue and static cling, this static cling window film avoids the release of chemical substances, very easy to install just spray A LOT of soap water to both the adhesive side and window. It can also be removed easily without any traces left on a glass.

WIDELY APPLICATION OCCASIONS: Our house window tint film suitable for the smooth and clean glass surface of your kitchen, sliding door, bedroom, balcony, rest room, office doors and windows. Not applicable to double-paned glass, frosted glass, cut glass and all of processed glass. Useful Tips: Please make sure the glass, edges and corners are totally cleaned without any dust and tear off the protective film before paste it onto the glass.
